title: Sokna language
description: Extinct Eastern Berber language of Libya
extract: Sokna is a presumably extinct Eastern Berber language which was spoken in the town of Sokna (Isuknan) and the village of Fuqaha in northeastern Fezzan, Libya. According to Václav Blažek (1999), Sokna was also spoken in the oasis of Tmassa.
